submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires retrospectively when the current token names or describes the natural environment or the cultivation of land: forests, grasslands, wetlands, wildlife habitat, farm and forestry life, and ecological adjectives such as natural, environmental, and sustainable, generalizing to class members absent from the scan peaks (savanna, meadow, wetland). It also has a secondary token-level sensitivity to the 'CO' subtoken in carbon/Colorado uses (CO2, 2016 COA citations) that drives it even without ecological content.
